protocol_identity.requirement: Identical training protocol for B and H across all benchmark points

gaussian_state.source: Real PLY files from official 3DGS pretrained models
gaussian_state.notes: Identical initial state loaded from point_cloud.ply

resolution.notes: Multipliers where applicable; width/height args to rasterization; eval always full target resolution

loss.reference: GT images (eval_images/) resized to target resolution
loss.lpips_weight: 0.0 (disabled in scaling study; used in separate quality-max studies)

densification.enabled: Only in higs_dynamic backend and Stage E full-training

measurement_protocol.timing_method: CUDA events (preferred) or perf_counter with sync

gradient_parity.notes: HiGS culling creates small differences; frozen path should match to ~1e-4

protocol_identity.verification: Benchmark harness enforces identical inputs; correctness gate validates before timing

acceptable.difference: HiGS culling removes invisible Gaussians from forward
acceptable.impact: Forward renders only visible subset; std renders all. Invisible Gaussians contribute zero to output.
acceptable.mitigation: Correctness gate verifies forward parity on visible subset; gradients on invisible rows are zero

acceptable.difference: HiGS native backward consumes different internal state
acceptable.impact: Implementation detail; transparent to training dynamics
